info.name: Aureus Finserve API
info.description:
REST API of the Aureus Finserve website (Spring Boot backend). Contract: docs/API.md.

1. Import this collection and one environment (Local or Live) and select it.
2. Set userId / password in the environment.
3. Run "0. Log in" step 1 and step 2: the token is saved and sent on every request.

Every request also sends an X-Device-Id header ({{deviceId}}).
Errors look like { "error": "...", "code": "...", "fields": { ... } }.

item.name: 0. Log in (run these first)
item.description: Set userId / password in the environment (admin, RM or investor), then run step 1 and step 2.

request.description: User ID = mobile, e-mail or PAN. Returns an OTP challenge. In dev mode the OTP comes back as devOtp and is saved to {{otp}} automatically.

exec: if (j.token) { pm.collectionVariables.set('token', j.token); console.log('Logged in as', j.user && j.user.name); }

request.description: Saves the session token to {{token}}; every other request sends it as Bearer auth. If dev mode is off, type the OTP from the SMS/e-mail into the otp variable first.
Keys: about, disclaimer, privacy, terms, commission, grievance

request.description: Choose a CAS PDF (≤10 MB) for the file field.

Residents: PAN_CARD, ADDRESS_PROOF, PHOTO, SIGNATURE (CANCELLED_CHEQUE optional). NRIs (residency=NRI) also need PASSPORT and OVERSEAS_ADDRESS_PROOF plus countryOfResidence, overseasAddress, taxResidencyCountry, foreignTin, nationality. Files: PDF/JPG/PNG ≤5 MB.
kind = statement | transactions | capital-gains; format = pdf | xlsx. Use "Send and Download".
